_comment: Pinned prompt set for `main.py sft-eval`. Held fixed so numbers compare across runs; changing it invalidates every recorded score. Deliberately covers the shapes cosmopedia pretraining did NOT teach: direct questions, imperatives, and short-answer requests. A base model should score ~0% on `stopped` here.
